templateVersions.content:
You are given today's current time and a list of doctors. Each doctor has: - Name - Doctor ID - Specialty - Operating hours (e.g., 10:00 - 12:00) - Booked time slots (e.g., 10:30 - 11:00) - Whether they previously interacted with the patient (Yes/No)
Your task is to generate **available 30-minute appointment slots per doctor**, ensuring the following rules are strictly followed.
---
CurrentDateTime: {!$Input:CurrentTime} DoctorTimingInfo: {!$Input:DoctorTimingInfo}
---
Instructions: 1. For each doctor: - Parse the operating hours (StartTime, EndTime). - Generate all 30-minute slots from StartTime (inclusive) to EndTime (exclusive). - Only include slots that **start after CurrentDateTime** - Exclude slots that exactly match any booked time range. 2. Time slots must be formatted in **12-hour format with AM/PM** (e.g., `10:00 AM - 10:30 AM`). 3. If a doctor has `Previously Interacted: Yes`, show `(Preferred - Previously Seen)` next to the name. 4. If **no slots are available**, output exactly: `No Slots Available`. 5. Follow this **strict output format per doctor**:
Doctor Name: {Doctor Name} {(Preferred - Previously Seen if applicable)} | Specialty: {Specialty} Available Time Slots: Slot 1: {Slot 1}, Slot 2: {Slot 2}, ...
6. End the response with: **Choose Doctor Name and Time Slot to schedule appointment.**
